# Configuration

compose.yaml reads the variables of .env in its directory. equori reads its process environment and, in managed mode, equori.env of its data directory (ADR 022, C2). At start, equori checks every variable it reads, prints one line per invalid value and exits with status 1.

## Installation

| Variable | Read by | Expected | Default | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | `compose.yaml` | letters A to Z, a to z and digits 0 to 9 | `equori` | `Zx81Qm4TfV9pLr2KcW7sNb3HdY6jGa5E` | Password of the database user of compose.yaml. PostgreSQL reads it only when it creates the pgdata volume; a later change needs the same change inside the database. |
| `EQUORI_PORT` | `compose.yaml` | a port from 1 to 65535 | `8080` | `8081` | Port of the host on which compose.yaml publishes equori. The installation script writes the first free port from 8080 to 8099. |
| `EQUORI_HOST_IP` | `compose.yaml` | an IP address | `127.0.0.1` | `0.0.0.0` | Address of the host on which compose.yaml publishes equori. 0.0.0.0 opens it to the network, which over plain HTTP also needs EQUORI_INSECURE_COOKIES=true (docs/operations/remote-access.md). |
| `EQUORI_COPY_FOLDER` | `compose.yaml` | a directory path | `./copies` | `/mnt/backup/equori` | Host folder that receives the encrypted copies of the backups. The container user, uid 999, writes into it. |
| `EQUORI_SECRET_KEY` | `equori` | 32 bytes in standard base64 | — | `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` | Key that seals the bank credentials, the second factor and the copy password (ADR 008); openssl rand -base64 32 writes one. Unset, the first start writes secret.key in EQUORI_DATA_DIR (compose.yaml mounts the appdata volume there); with no data directory, those features are unavailable. A new key makes the stored credentials unreadable, so a copy of .env stays apart from the backups. |
| `EQUORI_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS` | `equori` | 32 bytes in standard base64 | — | `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=` | The replaced key during a rotation: set it, run equori secrets rotate, then remove it. |
| `EQUORI_LOG_LEVEL` | `equori` | debug, info, warn or error | `info` | `debug` | Lowest level of the records equori writes. |
| `EQUORI_INSECURE_COOKIES` | `equori` | true or false | `false` | `true` | true drops the Secure attribute of the session cookie, which a login over plain HTTP from another host needs (ADR 003). |
| `EQUORI_API_DOCS` | `equori` | true or false | `false` | `true` | true serves the API reference at /docs and the contract at /openapi.yaml, both without a session. |

## Advanced

| Variable | Read by | Expected | Default | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EQUORI_DISTRIBUTION` | `equori` | compose or empty | — | `compose` | compose.yaml sets compose, so the notice of a newer release names the upgrade command of that form (A194). |
| `EQUORI_VERSION` | `compose.yaml` | a release version | — | `1.0.0` | Image version of compose.yaml. A release sets its own version as the default; in a clone the default is dev, which compose builds. |
| `EQUORI_DATABASE_URL` | `equori` | a postgres:// or postgresql:// URL | — | `postgres://equori:password@db:5432/equori?sslmode=disable` | URL of a PostgreSQL 18 database (external mode); compose.yaml sets it. Unset, equori runs its own PostgreSQL server over EQUORI_DATA_DIR (managed mode). |
| `EQUORI_HTTP_ADDR` | `equori` | host:port with a port from 1 to 65535 | `:8080` | `127.0.0.1:8081` | Address on which equori listens. compose.yaml keeps the container on :8080 and publishes it through EQUORI_HOST_IP and EQUORI_PORT. |
| `EQUORI_DATA_DIR` | `equori` | a directory path | — | `/var/lib/equori` | Data directory of managed mode. Unset: %ProgramData%\equori on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/equori on macOS, $XDG_DATA_HOME/equori or ~/.local/share/equori on Linux. |
| `EQUORI_POSTGRES_BIN` | `equori` | the directory of the postgres and pg_dump programs | — | `/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin` | Directory of the PostgreSQL 18 programs for managed mode, backups and restore. Unset: postgresql/bin beside the executable, else the directory of postgres on PATH. |
| `EQUORI_BACKUP_DIR` | `equori` | a directory path | — | `/backups` | Directory of the automatic backups; compose.yaml sets /backups. Unset: backups in the data directory in managed mode, no automatic backup in external mode. |
| `EQUORI_COPY_DIR` | `equori` | a directory path | — | `/copies` | Directory of the encrypted copies in the file system of the process; compose.yaml sets /copies and mounts EQUORI_COPY_FOLDER on it. |

## Development

| Variable | Read by | Expected | Default | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EQUORI_AGGREGATOR_<ID>_URL` | `equori` | an http:// or https:// URL | — | `https://aggregator.example` | Base URL of the API of an aggregator, by its ID (pluggy), in place of its public address; tests and fakes set it. |
| `EQUORI_FEED_<ID>_URL` | `equori` | an http:// or https:// URL | — | `https://feed.example` | Address of a price, index or expectation feed, by its ID, in place of its public address; tests and fakes set it. |
| `EQUORI_WEB_DEV_PORT` | `equori` | a port from 1 to 65535 | — | `5173` | Port of the Vite development server, to which pages redirect on the same host (ADR 028). Unset, equori serves the embedded application. |
| `EQUORI_DEV_DB_PORT` | Makefile, tests | a port from 1 to 65535 | `54329` | `54330` | Host port of the development database of compose.dev.yaml (make db-up). |
| `EQUORI_TEST_DB_PORT` | Makefile, tests | a port from 1 to 65535 | `54339` | `54340` | Host port of the test database of compose.dev.yaml (make db-test-up). |
| `EQUORI_TEST_DB_SERVICE` | Makefile, tests | a service of compose.dev.yaml | `db-test` | `db-test` | Service of compose.dev.yaml in which the backup test runs pg_dump (make test). |
| `EQUORI_TEST_DATABASE_URL` | Makefile, tests | a postgres:// or postgresql:// URL | — | `postgres://equori:equori@127.0.0.1:54339/postgres?sslmode=disable` | URL of the test server that the Go tests read; the Makefile sets it from EQUORI_TEST_DB_PORT. |
| `EQUORI_TEST_POSTGRES_BIN` | Makefile, tests | the directory of the postgres and pg_dump programs | — | `/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin` | Directory of the PostgreSQL programs for the managed-mode tests (make test-cluster). |
| `EQUORI_DEMO_PASSWORD` | Makefile, tests | a password | `equori-demo-account` | `demo-password-2026` | Password of the demo user of make demo. |
| `EQUORI_EVAL_KEY` | Makefile, tests | an API key of the provider | — | `eval-key` | Key of the provider that the evaluation tests (build tag eval) call; only the owner sets it. |
